T109 artifacts remain reachable through their legacy reader. A formal SUPERSEDE amendment annotating T109 with `superseded_by T112` is the contract's separate route and is out of scope for this attempt.

The fix-empty source refusal is enforced at the orchestrator's T100ReplayEventSource.load_events() entry. Test harnesses that previously injected empty event sources will now raise FixedEmptyEventSourceError; reviewers should expect this behaviour to surface in any test that did not previously provide partition-backed events.

The `test_workflow_state_derivation.py::test_every_guard_answers_the_same_over_the_whole_history` and `test_workflow_state_derivation.py::test_derived_status_reproduces_every_historical_revision` failures are pre-existing and unrelated to this attempt — they reference historical status semantics that pre-date 2026-09-15.
